reference_role: Viewed city mood reference; not an edit target or copied vehicle design.

choices.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original city-car concept direction for an irreverent top-down city game. Use the previously viewed island image only as a visual mood reference: ordinary city forms with dark petrol blue night and vibrant restrained coral/cyan illumination.
Create one landscape concept sheet with two large clearly separated views of THE SAME CAR: left a front-left three-quarter view, right a STRICT VERTICAL overhead roof view with front pointing toward top of page, NO camera tilt in that right view. Clean dark blue-grey matte studio background, readable lit body and soft grounding shadows. Smooth stylized 3D render look, broad chunky simplified volumes, softly bevelled manufactured surfaces, practical four-wheel passenger car with plausible doors and windows. Readable roof/hood/front-rear distinction is essential at small game scale. Keep glow subtle so geometry stays legible.
Include at bottom a small solid ivory overhead silhouette of the same car on charcoal; silhouette must distinguish front and rear. This is visual concept exploration, not an engineering drawing or measured gameplay capture.
Constraints: entirely original unbranded design; no real makes, logos, license plates, writing, people, city scenery, decals, weapons, hover parts, spikes, exaggerated aero, exposed engine or detailed greebles. Show all four wheels in the overhead view, exactly two on each side, tucked against body; consistent panels and shape between views. No labels or text.
Direction A: LATCH compact commuter. Short rounded wedge-shaped three-door city hatchback, approximately 3.40 m long, 1.88 m wide over tires, 1.54 m high (exploratory proportions). Warm coral-orange paint, dark petrol cabin glass and charcoal lower body, small ivory hood inset. A relatively wide curved roof, broad trapezoidal windshield, stubby rear deck, rounded corners and muscular but restrained wheel arches. Forward end identifiable by a short tapered hood and two warm ivory corner headlights; rear has two modest red bars. A cheerful everyday cheap city car with attitude, not a sports car. No roof rack or roof lights.

Direction B: CRATE utility hatch. Boxy practical five-door city hatchback, approximately 3.65 m long, 1.90 m wide over tires, 1.64 m high (exploratory proportions). Pale warm ivory main paint, petrol teal hood and lower bumper, dark smoked cabin glass. Tall upright cabin, squared broad flat roof with two shallow stamped ribs, steep rear hatch and a short blunt nose, soft bevels on chunky rectilinear forms. Clearly distinct from a rounded commuter: long rectangular roof, nearly vertical back. Four normal side doors and a rear hatch, substantial black rubber bumpers, simple round corner headlights recessed in a rectangular face. Working-day neighborhood grocery/runabout character, no roof cargo or roof rails.

Direction C: SABLE street sedan. Plausible four-door low city sedan, approximately 4.25 m long, 1.92 m wide over tires, 1.44 m high (exploratory proportions). Deep aubergine-purple paint with muted coral hood inset, broad dark petrol windows, charcoal lower trim and tires. Long hood, compact centered trapezoid roof, pronounced separate short rear trunk. Chunky smooth slab shoulders, rounded bevelled edges, plain closed front face with two narrow warm ivory light strips and modest red rear corner lights. Distinct three-box silhouette and roof-to-body proportion from the two hatchbacks. A tired neighborhood executive car with restrained cyberpunk lighting, no racing stripe, spoilers, performance aero or real-car resemblance.
